contributes.instructions: The Impeccable plugin brings Impeccable's design verbs (impeccable.style) to a viewport on the canvas: bolder, quieter, typeset, layout, colorize, delight open three draft variants beside the source; distill, polish, clarify, animate, adapt rework the source in place as an edit draft. When the user asks for one of these verbs — by name or in plain words ("make this bolder", "the type needs work") — call impeccable_verb {verb} FIRST: it answers with the target (the canvas selection unless viewport / element are given), the deliverable, and Impeccable's own playbook and craft floor, read from the skill installed on this machine; then follow it. The same text is offered as MCP prompts (impeccable-<verb>) for a client that picks prompts from a menu. Run a verb only when the user asks for it; never on a landing by itself.

permissions.name: reads the installed Impeccable skill
permissions.reason: each prompt reads reference/<verb>.md and reference/craft-floor.md from ~/.agents/skills/impeccable (or the project's .agents/skills/impeccable) at request time, so the plugin follows whatever version is installed
